problem_context.problem_statement: 为 CRTOS 原函数 CircularAreaGetDataLength 及其真实调用点补充完整 separation-logic annotation 并证明全部 VC。保持 CircularAreaIsFull/CircularAreaGetDataLength 的函数名、签名和函数体与 Ubiquitous kernel/thread/circular_area.c 一致；函数 spec 不使用参数 @pre，直接使用参数名；仅允许 parser-compatible typedef/include 调整与 annotation/case_lib 修改。
problem_context.expected_behavior: 空指针返回 uint32 ERROR；合法非空 descriptor 若 full 则返回 area_length，否则按 CRTOS 原表达式 (writeidx-readidx+area_length)%area_length 返回当前数据长度；所有 descriptor 字段与完整 data_buffer 数组所有权保持不变。
problem_context.input_output_contract: 非空分支完整拥有 CircularArea 八个字段和 UCharArray.full；要求 0<area_length、readidx/writeidx 在容量范围，确保取模安全；返回值精确对应 full/非 full 两分支，且资源不变。不得弱化成 emp/emp 或只读三个字段。
spec_hint: CircularAreaIsFull 的函数规格应可在 CircularAreaGetDataLength 调用点直接建立；最终规格还应能被 CircularAreaRead/CircularAreaWrite 调用点复用。
forbidden_patterns: 不得修改函数体或 API；不得读取 QCP_demos_human；不得使用 forbidden_lemma.md 中任何 lemma。

annotation_design_summary.algorithm_mirror_review: passed: the lib defines extensional result predicates only; it introduces no Fixpoint, loop transition system, or duplicate array predicate

case_lib_spec_declarations.meaning: classifies full exactly as equal indices with nonzero status and otherwise returns false
case_lib_spec_declarations.name: CircularAreaIsFullResult

case_lib_spec_declarations.meaning: full returns area_length; non-full returns the exact result of the original uint32 expression, including both unsigned wraps before remainder
case_lib_spec_declarations.name: CircularAreaDataLengthResult

annotation_design_summary.implementation_preservation: Function names, signatures through the CircularAreaType alias, and both function bodies are unchanged. Only parser-compatible primitive typedef placement and annotations were added.
annotation_design_summary.invariants: not applicable: neither target function contains a loop
annotation_design_summary.mathematical_postcondition: Null returns UINT_MAX. A non-null full descriptor returns area_length. A non-full descriptor returns Z.rem (unsigned_last_nbits (unsigned_last_nbits (writeidx-readidx) 32 + area_length) 32) area_length.
annotation_design_summary.ownership_contract: Both non-null function contracts own and preserve all eight CircularArea fields plus UCharArray.full(data_buffer, area_length, contents).
annotation_design_summary.range_contract: 0 < area_length <= UINT_MAX; readidx and writeidx are uint8-range values and strictly below area_length.
